ZERO FIELDS IS THE CORRECT, DELIBERATE ANSWER FOR THIS PAGE. The Budget Configuration page (/expense/admin/invoice/budgetConfiguration.asp) HAS NO DOCUMENTARY BASIS IN THIS CORPUS, and I am stating that explicitly rather than padding it.

REFUTER PAGE-LEVEL FINDINGS: the refuters returned an EMPTY findings list, and the KEEP, REPAIR and DROP lists were all empty (0/0/0), because all three extractor lenses (procedures-and-controls, tables, tools-guides-and-cross-cutting) independently emitted zero fields and zero valueSetCandidates. There was therefore nothing to keep, nothing to repair and nothing to drop. Rather than rubber-stamp a triple negative, I re-ran the search independently before accepting it.

WHAT I VERIFIED MYSELF (not inherited from Map/Extract). Across all four directories (2230 files: 1209 admin-guides, 650 tools-guides, 138 release-notes, 233 release-note-summaries) the literal strings 'Budget Configuration', 'budgetConfiguration', 'Budget Admin', 'Budget Item', 'Budget Manager', 'Budget Viewer', 'Budget Category', 'Manage Budget', 'Budget Period', 'Budget List' and 'budget setting' each return ZERO files, case-insensitively. A nav-shape search for '> Budget' or 'Budget >' returns ZERO lines, so there is NO navigation path to record. The token '.asp' appears in ZERO files corpus-wide, so the page URL itself is unverifiable from the docs by design, not by omission. Case-insensitive 'budget' returns exactly 22 files: 16 admin-guides + 6 tools-guides + ZERO in EITHER release-note directory. That release-note silence is a real corroboration of absence and also means there is no release note to date or differentiate a UI variant, which is why uiVariant stays 'undifferentiated'. Exactly one file carries 'budget' in its name: budget-approval-59251c3b.md, 27 lines total, which I read IN FULL. It contains no procedure, no field table, no button, no nav path.

THE CORPUS DEFERS OUTWARD TO A GUIDE THAT IS NOT HERE. Four independent files point at one external deliverable, the 'Shared: Budget Setup Guide', which is NOT in this corpus (this corpus is Concur Invoice Professional Edition only, deliverable_ids 41460672 admin-guides and 41460673 tools-guides; Shared deliverables were out of scope of the 2026-08-29 crawl). Verbatim, each grep -F -c verified at count 1: budget-approval-59251c3b.md -- 'For more information about budget approval and budget workflows, refer to the _Shared: Budget Setup Guide_.' and 'Clients who use the Budget feature can set up budget approval for both invoices and purchase requests.'; approver-terminology-8559861c.md line 39 -- the same outward pointer for the Budget Approver role; add-a-custom-audit-rule-0f1d320e.md AND its gerund/imperative twin add-a-custom-audit-rule-43e3f9aa.md, both at line 154 -- 'Complete the fields. (For audit rule notifications for Budget, refer to the Shared: Budget Setup Guide.)', i.e. the corpus defers at the exact point where budget notification fields would have been enumerated. THE CONFIGURATION SURFACE OF THIS PAGE IS DOCUMENTED, JUST NOT IN THIS CORPUS. That is the deliverable for this page.

PROVISIONING FACT worth carrying to the automation: vat-at-the-line-item-level-itemization-summary-only-a41e7ad6.md states 'The Budget feature is a purchased service.' A site that has not purchased it will not surface this page at all -- consistent with the corpus never documenting its controls. This is a provisioning gate, not a configurable control, so it is not emitted as a field.

BUDGET REFERENCES I REFUSED TO RE-HOME HERE (the mis-assignment failure grep cannot catch). (a) the-condition-page-5d4ea870.md defines a Budget audit-rule DATA OBJECT -- 'Budget: Budgets associated with an invoice or purchase request' -- whose 14 operands (Actual Pending Consumption Percent, Actual Spent Consumption Percent, Alert Limit, Budget Amount, Budget Name, Budget Remaining Amount, Budget Type, Committed Pending Consumption Percent, Committed Spent Consumption Percent, Control Limit, HasBudget, Pending Consumption Percent, Period Type, Spent Consumption Percent) I read IN FULL and confirmed sit in a column of the Condition page's data-object table. They belong to page.audit-rules, ALREADY BUILT with coverage 'good'. These operand names are exactly what a plausible budget screen would be fabricated from, and that is precisely why they stay out. (b) events-triggers-72339a13.md documents the workflow event 'Payment Request Budget Submit' -- Workflows, NOT YET BUILT. (c) workflow-667cee21.md frames budget approval as a Workflow capability. (d) approver-terminology-8559861c.md defines the Budget Approver role (SAP's subject-verb error 'approvers approves' is verbatim in the source). (e) define-the-who-in-a-transaction-1488d041.md uses 'Budget Center' only as an EXAMPLE accounting segment name -- Accounting Administration, already built. (f) benefits-of-using-cost-object-approval-ed5de5de.md's 'budget ownership' is Cost Object Approval prose, not a Budget Owner role. (g) general-information-8b3b0308.md, purchase-request-and-purchase-order-8b36ae07.md and audit-rules-8b297db8.md hits are revision-history lines.

RULE 1 (BOTH DIRECTORIES WEIGHTED EQUALLY) DISCHARGED, AND IT CORRECTS THE RECON. The Map inventory listed no tools-guides files at all, but six tools-guides files do contain the token 'budget'. I opened and line-grepped every one, and all six are INCIDENTAL COMMON-NOUN PROSE, not the Budget feature: create-and-manage-allocation-favorites-22cb2e7c and -4d3a7e54 ('budget the expense', a verb); distribute-allocate-a-purchase-request-689dbc62 ('managing departmental budgets'); select-for-different-vendors-and-project-and-event-based-requests-1f3c9d5b ('budget appropriate'); understand-conditional-expressions-db3d7418 ('EuropeBudget', an invented example group name inside an audit-rule expression); workflow-and-approval-routing-8b4ff6c9 ('budget insight', Workflows routing advice). None yields a field, a value or a role gate for this page. The tools-guides skew this lens exists to correct genuinely has nothing to contribute here -- which is itself a publishable finding.

RULE 2 AND RULE 3 DISCHARGED. Raw <table> census is ZERO across all 22 budget-bearing files, so no raw-HTML catalog was missed and no fromRawHtmlTable flag could be wrong. No long catalog belongs to this page; the only enumeration in the vicinity is the 14-operand Budget data object, which I read complete and un-truncated and then assigned to Audit Rules where it belongs. Nothing was sampled or summarised.

MUST-READ: the must-read list was empty by design and I did not manufacture a reading list; mustReadSkipped is therefore empty. I did read both ALSO RELEVANT files (budget-approval-59251c3b.md in full, approver-terminology-8559861c.md at the Budget Approver bullet) plus every other budget-bearing file in the corpus.

NO SPLITS PROPOSED: a split requires a control to split, and there are none.

WHAT I COULD NOT DETERMINE: everything about this page's actual controls -- whether it has budget name, budget type, period type, control/alert limit, or owner fields; whether the Condition-page operand names mirror on-page field labels (plausible, and therefore forbidden to assume); what roles gate it; and where it hangs in the nav tree.

RECOMMENDATION TO THE MERGE: keep page.budget-configuration ONLY as an explicit zero-field 'documented elsewhere' marker naming the Shared: Budget Setup Guide, or omit the node entirely. Either is defensible; the marker is more useful because it tells a future config writer immediately WHERE to look instead of leaving them to re-run this search. Under no circumstances should a later pass synthesise a plausible budget-configuration screen from the Audit Rules operand list. coverage='thin' and THIN STAYS THIN.
